headline: Sentiment-driven doom loop risk: consumer confidence deeply pessimistic and strongly correlated with home sales volumes; watching RBA inflation trajectory as the key turning point

So I think, you know, sentiment being as low as what it is... this does look like a bit of a doom loop in the sense that confidence is very low. It won't stay that way forever.
